faq.q: What are Chilliwack's suite rules for a detached home under $1.8M?
faq.a: Under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000 as verified in this program: a secondary suite is capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the principal dwelling, only 1 accessory dwelling unit is permitted per lot, garden suites are capped at 100 m², and ADU parking is set at s.5.04; Chilliwack's SSMUH amendment is Bylaw 5395, adopted June 18, 2024.

faq.q: How much property transfer tax applies under $1.8M?
faq.a: Under the Province's general rates — 1% on the first $200,000, 2% on the portion above $200,000 up to and including $2,000,000, and 3% above $2,000,000, plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3,000,000 — a home under $1.8M is taxed in the 1% and 2% tiers only. Exemption thresholds are not verified in this file; have a lawyer or notary model the exact tax before you offer.

faq.q: When are property taxes due on a Chilliwack home in this band?
faq.a: To the City of Chilliwack: notices are mailed annually at the end of May, taxes are due the first working day after July 1, a 5% penalty applies to taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026, and an additional 5% penalty to taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Chilliwack?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Chilliwack?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
